name: Staff heartbeat (one tick per active staff agent: collect, claim, at most one model call, act by autonomy level)

knobs.note: BH-5561: 0 stops every staff tick after the kill-flag check and before any roster read. Read by bin/staff.sh as ${STAFF_ENABLED:-1}; out of range is one warn line and the default.
BH-5561: collector lines claimed per agent per tick, all judged in ONE model call. More than this: the rest are not claimed and come back next tick (logged deferred=<n>).
BH-5561: model calls one finding may cost. A finding already at the cap is recorded failed with no call. The counter is written before the call.
BH-5561: timeout on bin/staff/<agent>-collect.sh. A collector that times out is rc 124: unreadable, nothing claimed.

BH-5561: USD cap on each staff tick's model call (passed as AGENT_CALL_BUDGET_USD_STAFF_TICK, one stage for every agent). Read by bin/staff.sh as ${STAFF_LLM_MAX_USD:-0.60}; not a number is one warn line and the default.

BH-5561: owner/repo where a staff agent files its tickets (label staff:<agent>, no ai-build label). Not owner/repo: one warn line and the default. NOT settable from the control plane: it names the repo a root lane writes to; set it in env/global.env.
Test seam: a file bin/staff.sh sources after its libs, only when HARNESS_TEST_SANDBOX=1. NOT settable from the control plane: it names a file a root lane sources.
Test seam gate: bin/staff.sh sources STAFF_FIXTURE only when this is 1 (the test harness sets it). Never set on a box, and NOT settable from the control plane.
Comma/space list of the ONLY ladder rungs the staff lane may reach. Empty is every rung, i.e. the stage.staff-tick ladder unchanged. A rung outside the list is refused before the call.

BH-5561: dollars the staff lane (every agent together) may spend in the current UTC day, summed from D1 cost_rows through GET /api/metrics/llm-spend. 0 is no cap here; the fleet row lane.staff.llm_usd_cap_day sets it with no deploy.
0 makes the staff lane call no model at all. bin/lib/llm-gate.sh refuses BEFORE the vendor call and writes a zero-cost row_source=refused row.
